name: God Speaking To You
overview: God actively communicates with His people, speaking clearly though often unnoticed, as Job 33:14 reveals. His words are powerful and purposeful, accomplishing His will without fail, according to Isaiah 55:11. Through prayer, believers are invited to call upon God and receive profound revelations beyond human understanding, as Jeremiah 33:3 encourages. Moreover, hearing God's voice requires obedient response, for Jesus warns that merely calling Him Lord without doing His commands is insufficient, highlighting the vital connection between hearing and doing in Matthew 7:24 and Luke 6:46.
